import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data into a pandas DataFrame
data = pd.DataFrame({
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
})

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a figure and a set of subplots
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a boxplot of amounts by transaction type
sns.boxplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', data=data, ax=ax)

# Set the title and labels
ax.set_title('Transaction Amounts by Type')
ax.set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax.set_ylabel('Amount')

# Save the plot as a .png file
plt.savefig('output.png')
